metadata.description: Get ready for a magical math adventure! In this enchanted escape room, kids journey through a whimsical forest solving fun and tricky math puzzles to unlock each new chapter. With silly characters, clever clues, and interactive narration, learning becomes an exciting quest. Press play, and begin the mission! Perfect for classrooms, homeschool, or rainy day fun! Simple Addition. Ages 5-8.

card.title: Math Explorers Escape Room - Enchanted Forest
